name: iRes_FTELL
comment: Original name iRes_FTELL (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (for a handle inside the MCMP handle array the position at +8, else the host ftell service +0x48); the counterpart of iRes_FSEEK; called by ihost_fseek / ihost_read here (the remaster inlined it)); was iMUSE_sounds__9e10.

name: iRes_FSEEK
comment: Original name iRes_FSEEK (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (for a handle outside the MCMP handle array the host fseek service +0x4c, else the position at +8 by whence 0 / 1 / 2 with the size at +4)); was iMUSE_sounds__9e40.

name: iMUSE_Malloc
comment: Original name iMUSE_Malloc (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (the host alloc service in sounds.c, then the pointer into the memory list mlEntries, which doubles when full); the remaster inlined FUN_10009f40 into it); was FUN_10009f10.

name: iMUSE_Free
comment: Original name iMUSE_Free (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (clear the pointer's slot in the memory list mlEntries, then the host free service); the remaster inlined FUN_1000a030 into it); was FUN_1000a010.
